## About
City Plumbing & Rooter is a family-owned and operated company. Having a family business was a dream for our co-founders, and now we work together in the office and out in the field to serve our community in Ventura and Los Angeles counties.
We don't just fix the problem in front of us. We like to show you what to look for, so you can head off leaks and drain clogs before they start. We truly believe you should know your plumber.
We're proud to be training the next generation of plumbing and drain specialists, and our neighbors have given us a 4.8 rating from 242 Google reviews.

## Services
- Drain Cleaning: Drain cleaning and drain clearing. New customers can use our coupon; present it when scheduling, and it can't be combined with another coupon. ($39.99)
- Hydro Jetting: High-pressure cleaning for drain and sewer lines, alongside our water line and sewer line work.
- Water Heater Repair: Repairs for leaking or failing water heaters.
- Tankless Water Heater: Repair and installation for traditional and tankless water heaters.
- Sewer Line Repair and Replacement: Diagnosis, repair and replacement of sewer lines.
- Slab Leak Detection: Finding and repairing leaks under the slab.
- Water Line Repair and Replacement: Repair or replacement of the water line to your home or business.
- Toilets, Sinks, Faucets and More: Help with toilets, sinks, faucets and anything running water. Present the coupon when scheduling; it can't be combined with another coupon. (10% Off)

## FAQ
Q: Are you licensed and insured?
A: Yes. Our team of professionals is qualified, licensed, and insured.

Q: Can you get the job done the same day?
A: Often, yes. A lot of the time we can finish the job the same day you call.

Q: What if I have a plumbing emergency?
A: Call us. Our 24/7 plumbing services have you covered in case of an emergency.

Q: How do I use a coupon?
A: Present the coupon when you schedule the work. Coupons can't be combined with another coupon.

Q: Do you have a discount for pet owners?
A: Yes. Dog and cat owners get a discount on any service repair.
